description_en: Queries the nodes of an Elastic High Performance Computing (E-HPC) cluster
kebab_example: aliyun ehpc list-nodes --cluster-id ehpc-hz-FYUr320000 --hostnames compute000 --private-ip-address 172.16.00.00 --page-number 1 --page-size 1 --sequence Forward --sort-by AddedTime --queue-names comp --status running --api-version 2024-07-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListNodes

parameters.description_en: The cluster ID. You can call the [ListClusters](~~87116~~) operation to query the cluster ID.
parameters.description_zh: 集群ID。您可以通过调用[listclusters](~~87116~~)获取集群ID。
parameters.help_en: The cluster ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html operation to query the cluster ID

parameters.description_en:
Specifies whether the results are sorted in ascending or descending order. Valid values:

*   Forward: ascending
*   Backward: descending

Default value: Forward.
parameters.description_zh:
节点列表排序方式。取值范围：
- Forward：正序排序。
- Backward：逆序排序。

默认值：Forward

parameters.description_en:
The sorting method of the node list. Valid values:

*   AddedTime: sorts the nodes by the time that they were added.
*   HostName: sorts the nodes by their hostnames.

Default value: addedtime.
parameters.description_zh:
节点列表排序方式。取值范围：
- addedtime：按加入时间排序。
- hostname：按节点主机名称排序。

默认值：addedtime
